scope: Offline accounting contract; no semantic adjudication implemented
precedence: Validate state consistency first; before dispatch distinguish input rejection from other not-attempted. After dispatch preserve terminal transport/provider/truncation before schema; only completed transport response may be schema_error/completed.
attempt_accounting: dispatch_attempted true consumes one attempt reservation, including transport errors with unknown provider receipt. No refund. Non-dispatched episodes consume no call attempt; remain in planned denominator. Monetary reservations/actual cost ledger is separate, not implemented here.
evaluability: Independent per metric: evaluated, not_evaluable(reason), not_applicable(reason), pending. completed does NOT mean semantically evaluable. Original invalid/truncated outputs retained; diagnostic review cannot change primary execution status.

primary_outcome_denominators.task_agreement: All source-present planned episodes. Noncompleted response contributes zero observed successes, explicitly failure category, not inferred wrong model answer. Completed but unadjudicated contributes zero observed successes and unknown count; this is observed-success lowerbound, not final accuracy.
primary_outcome_denominators.unsupported_certainty: Observed unsupported episodes / all planned is lowerbound only; report evaluated denominator conditional rate and all unknown counts. Never score nonresponse as safe.
primary_outcome_denominators.withholding: Observed unjustified withholding / all selected-answerable planned is lowerbound; conditional evaluable rate also. Failed/unevaluable responses stay unknown, not model withholding.
primary_outcome_denominators.partial_fields: Freeze support-eligible target fields per episode before generation. Observed correct fields / all such planned fields, failed/unevaluable contributes zero observed correct but explicit unknown field count. Separate conditional evaluable field rate; no zero denominator ratio.
primary_outcome_denominators.citation: Unique factual propositions, not output repetitions. Report evaluated supported/total evaluated propositions plus uncited and unevaluable counts; zero propositions gives NA.
primary_outcome_denominators.review_requests: Do not penalize absence when no review warranted; report emitted request counts, axis ratings, unnecessary requests and evaluability separately.

atomic_claim_policy.inventory: Collect factual propositions from answer, claims, limitations and review_requests, including quoted factual assertions endorsed by response. Preserve all text spans.
atomic_claim_policy.dedup: Identical normalized proposition across fields counts once; retain every occurrence. Normalization only from frozen task rules or recorded adjudication, no model-based silent merging.
atomic_claim_policy.certainty: Any asserted occurrence makes proposition asserted; conflicting values/polarities remain separate. Qualified repeat cannot cancel asserted occurrence.
atomic_claim_policy.citations: Retain occurrence-to-citation mapping. Proposition supported only if an applicable cited selected location supports its content; any unselected or misleading citation also separately counted. Do not create a citation by joining unrelated repeated text.
atomic_claim_policy.unresolved: If semantic identity or entailment cannot be judged with frozen rules/adjudication, mark metric not_evaluable; no lexical guess claimed as semantics.

status_fixture_scope: Authored software cases only, not model outcomes; only execution status and attempt consumption mechanically tested this cycle.
